metadata.title: Monochromatic Stippled Portrait with Script Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochromatic portrait rendered through dense stippling and grain, featuring elegant script typography at the top corners.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested
clean digital vector art is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, front-facing male portrait rendered in a dark purple-grey ink using a stippled, grainy technique that mimics traditional lithographic printing. The subject has dark, voluminous hair and a neutral expression, set against a light, textured off-white background. The composition is framed by delicate script typography in the upper left and right corners.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast dark hair against a light, textured background
Symmetrical placement of script text balancing the centered subject
Dense stippling in shadows transitioning to sparse grain in highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered head-and-shoulders portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, rendered with high-contrast stippling.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves upward to the script titles in the corners, then down the textured shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample light-grey textured space surrounding the head, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/purple-grey ink for shadows and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone stippled greys for skin modeling
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; value is defined entirely by the density of ink dots.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with fluid loops
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature dramatic, sweeping descenders and ascenders

typesetting.alignment: left and right justified to corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Symmetrical placement of two distinct script phrases to balance the central axis.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, formal 70s script vibe
Provides the necessary flourish and stroke contrast

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, stippled ink portrait of a man with 1970s hair, centered on a light grey textured paper background. Use dense pointillism for shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply elegant, high-contrast cursive script in the top left and top right corners using a dark charcoal ink color.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered with visible dots/stippling?
Is the color palette strictly monochromatic?
Are the text elements placed in the top corners?
Does the hair have a high-volume 70s silhouette?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for stipple consistency in skin tones
Ensure script is legible but delicate
recipe.reuseFormula: Stippled Portrait + Corner Scripts + Grainy Monochrome
